title: [finding] the clause-② enqueue gate's path limb covers every file under packages/spec/src, but contract-review.md exempts test files from the review it demands — a test-only spec PR from an off-tier seat can never enqueue
body:
Ruled: 5805897677 · letter A · 2026-09-24T01:38Z

Filing gate: **① a defect with a named landing site** (the PM protocol text). Two rules in the same skill give contradictory answers for one diff shape, and following both is impossible. Filed by `domain:spec` execution seat 1 (`session_013RDBh5DqXd2xnLwvHLgLFr`, seat post #6017). ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim. The seat acts on the stricter reading meanwhile (「两条细则冲突 ⇒ 按更严的一条行动并立卡」).

## The two texts, read on origin/main fdeeea0cc9

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md`, section 入队与落地:

> 双肢命中任一 ⇒ 无达档条款②复核 PASS 在案 ⛔ 禁止入队。
> 路径肢 = diff 触及契约面 `packages/spec/src/**`,含 error-code-ledger 与 `*.zod.ts` 契约 schema。

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md`, section 复核归属与资格(按面):

> 加已发布 schema(`packages/spec/src/**` 非测试)与 governed 规则文本
> 五面皆不碰 ⇒ CI 加席位自读 ⛔ 不起第二个 agent;谁跑 = 派发席,达档者席内审。

`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` `SUSPECT_TIER_GLOBS` is `packages/spec/src/**`, with no test exclusion either.

## The diff shape where they collide

Take a PR whose only file is a test under `packages/spec/src`, for example PR #19932: one file, `packages/spec/src/type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts`.
- The path limb fires ⇒ no enqueue without an at-tier PASS on file.
- contract-review.md says the diff touches none of the five surfaces ⇒ no second agent; the dispatching seat reads it, and only an at-tier seat reviews in-seat.

For an off-tier seat those two answers are "you must have an at-tier record" and "you must not spawn the agent that would write one". The PR cannot enqueue by any path the protocol allows.

## What would decide it (⛔ not chosen here)

- Narrow the path limb to non-test files, to match contract-review.md.
- Or widen contract-review.md's surface to all of `packages/spec/src/**`, to match the limb.

Either one is a governed-surface edit.

## Dedupe

`mcp__github__search_issues` (repo-scoped), 2026-09-24:
- 「clause-② enqueue gate path limb packages/spec/src test files excluded contract review surface non-test」: total_count 97, top 10 read.
- 「test-only PR under packages/spec/src owes at-tier contract review SUSPECT_TIER_GLOBS」: total_count 111, top 10 read.

The nearest is #16912 (closed), on two readings of the same gate: a different split, not the test exemption. No hit names the test-file mismatch.
